purpose: Define the generated narrow-waist runtime profile index used by answer_case.py so answer emission does not repeatedly join route, remedy, policy-action, and actor surfaces.
drift_rule: Every entry must exactly mirror one live route record and its remedy, policy-action, and actor-accountability profiles; tools/audit_route_profile_index.py blocks stale or orphaned entries.
runtime_rule: Answer emission should load this runtime index, not join the three profile registries directly.
